title: Painting Estimate Template: Fill In, Download PDF, Word, Excel
description: Price interior or exterior painting in your browser: rooms, sq ft, coats, prep, lead-safe notes. No sign-up. PDF, Word, Excel, with US ranges and sources.
lede_html: Use this form to price a paint job and download a PDF, Word or Excel estimate. There is no account. The sample is three rooms in an older home. Enter your rooms.

sample.scope: Paint walls, ceilings and trim in 2 bedrooms and hall. Two coats. Patch nail holes and small cracks. Move and cover furniture. Home built 1962: lead-safe work practices.
sample.exclusions: Wallpaper removal, plaster repair over 1 sq ft, closets, doors.
sample.terms: Paint: owner color choice, mid-grade washable. Color change after start is a change order.

must_show.heading: What a painting estimate should say
must_show.intro_html: A paint estimate says which surfaces, how many coats, how much prep and which paint. Most price gaps between two painters come from prep, so write it down.
must_show.why_label: Why it matters on a paint job
rows: Walls, ceilings, trim and doors are separate decisions.
Name the coats and the product line, or who buys the paint.
Patching, sanding, caulk and primer. Say how much is included.
A home from before 1978 can bring the EPA lead rule.
Say who moves furniture and how you cover floors.
A new color after the start can need another coat.

example.heading: Filled example: exterior repaint, 1,800 sq ft
example.intro_html: A second job at sample prices, priced per square foot.

line_items.heading: Painting line items and typical prices
line_items.intro_html: Tap Add to put a line on the form. The range comes from the source in the same row. The price that the button adds is a sample inside that range, not a price recommendation.

rules.heading: Rules to check before you send a painting estimate

items.title: Lead-safe work in older homes
items.html: Under the EPA rule, paid work that disturbs painted surfaces in homes, childcare facilities and preschools built before 1978 falls under the Renovation, Repair and Painting Program. Lead-safe certified firms do the work. Name your certification on the estimate.

items.title: Trained staff
items.html: EPA says that workers must be trained, either as a certified renovator or on the job by a certified renovator. Keep the training record with the job file.

items.title: State license class
items.html: California has a C-33 Painting and Decorating class that covers preparing a surface and applying paints and similar materials. Other states set their own limits. Print the number your state gave you.

faq.q: Should I price by the room or by the square foot?
faq.a: Rooms are easy for customers. Square feet suit exterior work and big interiors. The form has a unit for each line, so use both on one estimate if you want.

faq.q: Do I include paint in the price?
faq.a: Say so either way. Add paint as a parts line if you buy it, or write in the exclusions that the owner buys it.

faq.q: How do I handle damage found under old wallpaper?
faq.a: Exclude it in the scope and set a unit price for skim coat or repair, so that no one argues later.

faq.q: Should the estimate give a finish date?
faq.a: Give a planned start and a duration in the scope. Weather can move exterior work, so say that in the terms.
